Name: Totoro Ghibli Anime Warp Obelisk retexture
Author: hisameartwork
Description:
Drag and drop the folder and it should work automatically. 

I test all the mods to make sure they work but I am not a coder, just an artist, I rely on the kindness of others to bring you these mods. 
Please report in the bug section any issues so they are documented. If you want to help me out you can contact me on [url=https://discord.gg/vkgSNJv22r][u][b]Discord[/b][/u][/url].

We hope to ad animations for each season. We also plan to have different cartoon figures for each Obelisk. Looking forward to your ideas.
